text: Materials physics and chemistry is an interdisciplinary field that integrates the core theories and technologies of physics, chemistry, and materials science, focusing on the relationship between the structure, properties, preparation, and application of materials. Its aim is to reveal the physical and chemical characteristics of materials at the atomic and molecular levels, and by designing and regulating the microstructure of materials, develop new types of materials with specific functions, serving multiple fields such as energy, electronics, environment, and biomedicine.
